objective: RULER-20261111-001 direction 1 (G1, question 9), at the coordinator's go-ahead of 2026-11-11 under the owner's standing mandate: carry the plane ruler (bond distance = graph distance + 1 under the not-all-equal knot) to 6-regular tori and Klein bottles. Frozen: on a torus Lambda/L, with M the best admissible tilt's margin (an invariant of L), bond distance is at least min(d, M/3) + 1, equals d + 1 whenever d < M/3, and the torus is read faithfully when M > 3; Klein bottles are attempted and left computed if the needed equivariant extension is not proved. Standalone value relative to the nearest known work: quasi-periodic height functions with a tilt are standard for tori (Kenyon, Okounkov and Sheffield for dimers); a proved range of the ruler in terms of a lattice invariant was not found.
stop_rule: One epic: a refereed proof for tori with the frozen range, or the first counterexample; Klein bottles proved or left computed. Report and hold.
